T: Mr Wilson will not be impressed.
D: A cheeky five-year-old drives his grumpy retired neighbour up the wall.
P: Serve dessert when Mrs Wilson brings out the cookies.
S: Butter, brown sugar and vanilla creamed, oats and chocolate chips folded in, baked at 180C for 12 minutes until golden at the edges.
Slingshot gruyère puffs with hot honey

Crisp little choux puffs loaded with gruyère and cracked pepper, baked hollow and hit with a drizzle of chilli honey and flaky salt. Pocket-sized ammo. Bring 250ml water and 100g butter to the boil, beat in 150g plain flour until it leaves the sides, then cool 5 minutes. Beat in 4 eggs one at a time, then 100g grated gruyere and cracked pepper. Pipe 30 small balls onto lined trays and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and hollow. Warm 3 tbsp honey with a pinch of chilli flakes, drizzle over and finish with sea salt.
the Wilsons' garden party for the rare flower
Cucumber rounds topped with cream cheese, dill and smoked salmon, and mini egg sandwiches cut into fingers.
M: Dennis at the campfire with Switchblade Sam

Thick pork snags charred over the fire, in toasted rolls with sticky caramelised onions, smoky mustard mayo and crunchy pickles. Slice 3 onions and cook slowly in 30g butter with 1 tbsp brown sugar for 25 minutes until sticky and dark. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 1 tbsp wholegrain mustard and half a tsp smoked paprika. Grill 8 thick pork sausages over medium coals or a barbecue for 15 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through. Toast 8 long rolls, spread with the mayo and fill with sausages, onions and sliced dill pickles.
Mr Wilson just wanting some peace
Lamb chops grilled with rosemary and garlic, with buttered mashed potato, peas and mint sauce.
W: Apples cooked with butter, sugar and cinnamon, baked in shortcrust with a lattice top at 190C for 45 minutes, with ice cream.
K: Fresh lemons squeezed with sugar syrup and cold water, poured into tall glasses with ice and a strawberry.

s.how: Cream 125g butter with 150g brown sugar and a teaspoon of vanilla, then beat in an egg. Fold in 150g flour, 100g rolled oats and 150g dark chocolate chips. Roll into balls and bake at 180C for 12 minutes until golden at the edges.

s.note: the Wilsons' garden party for the rare flower
s.how: Slice 2 Lebanese cucumbers into thick rounds and top each with cream cheese, a fold of smoked salmon and a sprig of dill. Hard boil 4 eggs, mash with salt and spread on white bread. Cut off the crusts and slice into fingers.

m.note: Mr Wilson just wanting some peace
m.how: Rub 8 lamb loin chops with rosemary, garlic and salt. Grill for 3 minutes a side and rest. Boil 800g potatoes and mash with butter. Cook peas and serve everything with a spoon of mint sauce, in peace, with no interruptions at all.

w.how: Cook 6 sliced green apples with 50g butter, 100g brown sugar and a teaspoon of cinnamon until just soft, then cool. Line a pie dish with shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice on top. Bake at 190C for 45 minutes and serve warm with ice cream.

d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Squeeze 6 lemons into a jug, add the syrup and 1.5L cold water and stir. Pour into tall glasses over ice and drop a halved strawberry into each. Serve in the backyard on a hot afternoon.
